overloadMerges.note: The signature 'Keystroke : Text' has no parameter list at all (Keystroke takes no arguments); the mechanical parser couldn't locate a '(...)' list and left params/returns entirely empty. Supplying params:[] explicitly and returns:Text from the parameter table's 'Function result' row (arrow-marked as output).
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the single character just entered by the user into the enterable area currently being edited; intended for use inside an On Before Keystroke/On After Keystroke form-event method (does not work in subforms).
